requiredEnv.name: AGL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN
requiredEnv.purpose: HTTPS origin used for hosted privacy/support URLs, sitemap, TWA host, and Digital Asset Links. If no custom origin is set, the setup helper can infer the zero-cost GitHub Pages origin from the repository target.

requiredEnv.name: AGL_SUPPORT_EMAIL
requiredEnv.purpose: Production support contact for privacy and store listings.

requiredEnv.name: POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID + POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY
requiredEnv.purpose: Optional autonomous production analytics and experiment result rollups from PostHog.

requiredEnv.name: VITE_EVENT_COLLECTOR_URL + AGL_EVENT_COLLECTOR_EXPORT_URL
requiredEnv.purpose: Optional zero-cost Worker/R2 event collector for browser analytics and autonomous rollups.

requiredEnv.name: VITE_ADSENSE_CLIENT_ID + VITE_ADSENSE_REWARDED_SLOT_ID
requiredEnv.purpose: Web/PWA rewarded or display-ad test configuration after product and privacy gates pass.

requiredEnv.name: ADMOB_PUBLISHER_ID
requiredEnv.purpose: Native app seller line for app-ads.txt and Android rewarded tests after app-store gates pass.

requiredEnv.name: AGL_ANDROID_SHA256_CERT_FINGERPRINT
requiredEnv.purpose: Android signing fingerprint for Digital Asset Links.

requiredEnv.name: AGL_GOOGLE_PLAY_ACCOUNT_CONNECTED
requiredEnv.purpose: Allows native packaging gates to treat Play Console access as connected.
